Overview of Both Tools

Digitail

Digitail is a cloud-based veterinary practice management platform founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. Marketed as "ai-native, all-in-one platform for modern veterinary clinics", it serves 10,000+ teams and is best suited for multi-location clinics, growing practices, ai-forward teams. The platform supports Small animal, General practice, Multi-location practice types.

Shepherd Veterinary Software

Shepherd Veterinary Software is a cloud-based veterinary software solution founded in 2020 and headquartered in USA. Described as "pims built by a vet who got it", it serves growing rapidly and is best suited for start-up practices, small clinics, solo veterinarians. It supports Small animal, General practice, Start-up practice types.

Feature-by-Feature Comparison

We evaluated Digitail and Shepherd Veterinary Software across six key areas that matter most to veterinary practices.

Clinical Features / EMR

Digitail wins

Digitail offers AI-powered SOAP notes (Tails AI), automated charge capture, and telemedicine. Shepherd Veterinary Software provides an intuitive EMR with treatment plans and a whiteboard, built from the perspective of a practicing veterinarian. Digitail has the broader clinical feature set, but Shepherd Veterinary Software's workflow design is praised for feeling natural to clinicians.

Scheduling & Booking

Digitail wins

Both offer appointment scheduling, but Digitail adds online booking and a mobile app for pet parents. Shepherd Veterinary Software keeps scheduling simple and focused, which suits small teams that do not need complex booking workflows.

Client Communication

Digitail wins

Digitail provides a full client communication app with telemedicine, while Shepherd Veterinary Software offers client communication and automated reminders. For practices that want a consumer-grade pet owner experience, Digitail is ahead. For practices that just need reliable reminders and messaging, Shepherd Veterinary Software covers the basics well.

Pricing & Value

Shepherd Veterinary Software wins

Shepherd Veterinary Software starts at $99/mo per location and offers a 50% discount for new practices, making it one of the most affordable options available. Digitail starts at $150/mo per veterinarian. For startup and solo practices, Shepherd Veterinary Software delivers far better value per dollar.

Integrations

Tie

Both tools integrate with major lab providers (IDEXX, Antech, Zoetis) and Stripe for payments. Digitail adds Covetrus integration. Shepherd Veterinary Software offers QuickBooks integration for accounting. The integration ecosystems are comparable for small-practice needs.

Ease of Use

Shepherd Veterinary Software wins

Both platforms are praised for intuitive design. Shepherd Veterinary Software was built by a veterinarian specifically to match how vets actually work, and users consistently rate it among the easiest PIMS to learn. Digitail also has a modern interface but includes more features, which adds some complexity.

Our Recommendation

The right choice here depends almost entirely on your practice size and budget. If you are a solo vet or opening a new practice, Shepherd Veterinary Software at $99/mo (with a 50% startup discount) is exceptional value. It does what a small practice needs without complexity you will not use. If you are a growing multi-location clinic that wants AI-powered notes and a full client app ecosystem, Digitail is worth the premium at $150/mo.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Digitail or Shepherd Veterinary Software cheaper?

Shepherd Veterinary Software is significantly cheaper at $99/mo per location, with an additional 50% discount for new practices. Digitail starts at $150/mo per veterinarian. For a startup practice, Shepherd Veterinary Software could cost less than half of what Digitail charges.

Which is better for a new veterinary practice?

Shepherd Veterinary Software was purpose-built for startup and small practices, with per-location pricing and a 50% startup discount. It covers all the essentials without overwhelming new teams. Digitail is better suited for practices that plan to scale quickly and want AI tools from day one.

Do both offer free trials?

Yes, both Digitail and Shepherd Veterinary Software offer free trials. Given their different price points and target audiences, trialing both is a good way to determine which complexity level your team actually needs.

Does Shepherd Veterinary Software have AI features like Digitail?

Not currently. Digitail's standout feature is its AI-powered SOAP note generation (Tails AI), which Shepherd Veterinary Software does not offer. If AI-driven documentation is a priority, Digitail is the clear choice. Shepherd Veterinary Software focuses on intuitive manual workflows designed by a practicing vet.
